description: This file is a shell script for testing various scenarios related to 'git merge' operations, including different merge strategies like octopus, fast-forward, non-fast-forward, and merging fetches and unrelated histories. It defines test setup functions and multiple test cases to verify behavior of git merge under different conditions.

methods.name: t3033_reset
methods.description: Resets the git repository state by configuring branches for testing merge scenarios.
